effect.name: Floating
effect.description: Gentle, automatic floating/drift motion (position + rotation). No keyframes needed: set amplitude and speed once and the clip hovers for its whole duration. Good for logos or PNGs placed on top of a video.
effect.author: marcoporz

parameter.name: speed
Speed
parameter.comment: Roughly how many oscillations per second. Lower = slower/dreamier, higher = jittery.

parameter.name: seed
Seed
parameter.comment: Changes the motion pattern. Give overlapping floating clips a different seed so they don't drift in sync.

parameter.name: pivot_x
Rotation Pivot X
parameter.comment: 0 = left edge of the frame, 0.5 = center, 1 = right edge.

parameter.name: pivot_y
Rotation Pivot Y
parameter.comment: 0 = top edge of the frame, 0.5 = center, 1 = bottom edge.
